training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.

architecture.shared_initialization: CNN input/output projections copy the exact seeded MLP64 linear weights, reshaped to 1x1 kernels

split_rule: Preserve old16 reference order and old12fit/4diagnostic. PCG64(seed+3000) permutation of lexicographically sorted unused normal training paths; first12 extra fit, last4 extra diagnostic; append all16 to reference bank.
primary_metric: Equal-category then equal-six-shift macro pixel AP within each paired seed. Differences are formed at category/seed/condition before aggregation.

category_change_rule.metric: six-shift macro pixel AP difference, averaged over paired seeds
category_change_rule.interpretation: Predeclared practical reporting threshold; not a significance test.

visualization_rule.case_selection: Lexicographically first defective test path in each of all15 categories, fixed before new scoring; no selection by model performance.
visualization_rule.map_color_scale: One shared scale across methods for each image and condition; display native image and ground truth.
visualization_rule.scale: Per case and condition, common zero to pooled-all-eight-method 99th percentile; no per-method rescaling.

scope: Stages1/2 capacity,16/32 normal data andCNN1/3 only. DINOv2-S/14 frozen. Stage3 loss experiments are not implemented.
restrictions: All15 categories and full official test sets; every category/seed fit independently; no cross-category mixture.
Train all225 new final-step heads before new test evaluation. No test-driven model changes, removal, stopping or checkpoint choice.
Same effective512 centers per step, identical normal/light views and center schedules within budget across methods; 1000 steps AdamW fixed.
Loss is illumination +0.1anchor only. No synthetic defect loss. Legacy inactive draws preserve RNG but enter neither forward nor loss.
Use actual featuregrid sizes. CNN neighborhoods come from the same image and view; per-layer masking matches full-image zero padding.
Each normal rotation passes through the adapter separately before flattening; reference counts/dimensions and exactNN/scoring/postprocessing unchanged.
Preserve old source,paper,results. Record failed attempts and retries separately. No datasets,large caches or pretrainedweights in Git.
Report allarms,allcategories,paired seeds and conditions. Original3 and earlier12 are both previously evaluated,not new unseenvalidation.
Categorymacro and conditionmacro are equalweighted. Seeds share the same testset and are not independent datasets; positive mean is not significance.
CNN depth also changes parametercount; do not interpret as parameter-controlled puredepth. 32shot expands both fitset and normal bank; compare samebudget A0.
